[[Petras]] is one of the [[Non-player character|NPC]]s that escort the [[Young Turtle]]s in [[Gyala Hatchery]] mission. He provides the players with [[Smoke Canister]]s for firing the [[Siege Turtle]]s. He can be found in [[Leviathan Pits]] after the mission.

==Dialogue==
;Leviathan Pits
:''"I grow weary of this place. We [[Luxon]]s are not meant to stay in one place for too long...."''

;Gyala Hatchery
When he gives out a Smoke Canister:
:''"When dropped, these smoke canisters indicate [[target]]s for the siege turtles to attack. I've only got three canisters, so you will need to reuse them. And don't leave any of them behind, got that?"''

When he has no more Smoke Canisters:
:''"I'm out of smoke canisters. You'll have to reuse one of the canisters already on the field."''
